newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH ORION'S CEO SAYS JOB MOVE PERSONAL CHOICE.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH ORION'S CEO SAYS JOB MOVE PERSONAL CHOICE.

text.p: Aatto Prihti, president and CEO of Finnish pharmaceuticals group Orion-yhtyma Oy , said on Monday he was leaving the company to head the SITRA fund because of personal interest in the new position.

"It was a difficult decision, but I consider SITRA (the Finnish National Fund for Research and Development) an interesting unit and the job interesting because of my background as a researcher," Prihti told Reuters by telephone.
He said the move, decided over the weekend, had nothing to do with Orion's earnings prospects nor with any internal reorganisation.
Orion's supervisory board was due to meet on Monday evening.
Prihti said his background in science would fit in well at SITRA, which funds various research projects at small Finnish high-tech firms as well as other ventures.
Prihti, 56, has been at the helm of Orion since 1991 and with the company since 1984, a spokesman said.
